title: Crank Duty Ended Event
description: Wingman went off duty. reason stopped: the operator took it off duty (the unit was stopped). reason failed: the duty loop died on an error it could not ride out; data.error says which. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (crank).

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket duty:<duty_id>: every fact of one duty session, in order.

duty_id.description: One duty session, from going on duty to going off. Also the envelope correlationid.

session.description: The zellij session watched, e.g. Workspace.

error.description: reason failed: the exception, one line. No stack trace.

ticks.description: Surveys run, by poll, event or due announcement.

alerts.description: crank.alert.raised facts emitted in this session.
